arena-overview: Restores 432 original placements with more detailed ground cover, flowers, small rock clusters and power equipment. Existing trees, tunnel catwalks, lighting and minimap are retained.
central-rocks: Additional supported plant and grass patches use authored source LODs. Dense vegetation and layered terrain shading still differ from Apex.
west-tunnel: Tunnel walls and the added Titanfall catwalk remain visible. No rendering portals were added in this pass.
west-tunnel-bend: The saved R5R reference at this bend is black, so it cannot establish a lighting difference. The port capture shows the tunnel surfaces and catwalk.
terrain-seam: Original terrain layers remain approximate; this pass adds objects rather than reconstructing Apex's layered terrain shader.
west-building: Existing green Apex display artwork is retained as a static texture. Animated display behaviour is not reproduced.

court-overview: Restores 366 utility, storage, furniture and structural placements across the gameplay area. Northstar banners, native minimap and previous display fixes are retained.
west-cargo: Additional source tanks, crates and storage details retain their original positions. Added surfaces use Drop-Off's existing ambient lighting settings.
north-platform: Additional conduits and equipment supports are restored. Working ziplines and deliberate room closures remain unchanged.
north-closure: The translucent closure remains intentional; the room is not a new gameplay route.
upper-west: Safety volumes and platform access remain unchanged. No geometry loading portals were introduced.
west-control: Original building textures and the previously corrected lighting are retained. Apex-specific animated and layered shader effects remain approximated.
